payload.comment: Evaluation stage is internally consistent with no deterministic findings. Verification summary: (1) Data audit passed all checks; train/validation overlap is zero; test was not inspected during training/selection (test_metrics_used=false). (2) Training history is coherent: 15 epochs completed, best epoch 12 (val_acc 0.9951), cosine LR schedule decays to 0, no anomalies in loss/accuracy trajectories. (3) Evaluation metrics are arithmetically consistent with the confusion matrix — spot-checked labels 0 and 7: precision, recall, and support all reconcile exactly. (4) Prediction artifact is well-formed (logits, probabilities, targets; 7180 test / 10004 validation samples; SHA-256 present). (5) ResNet18 fixed topology correctly applied: hidden=48 sets base width, depth=3 is inert, generic transformer fields (mlp_ratio, num_heads, patch_size, pooling, positional_encoding, tokenizer_layers) are inactive for this CNN family. (6) Augmentations (hflip, rotate180) are built-in primitives; no extension approval required. (7) Selection rule is validation-only; no test-dependent adaptation. Advisory (non-blocking) notes carried forward: (a) the ~9 pp gap between best validation accuracy (0.995) and test accuracy (0.906) is a legitimate performance observation, not a pipeline defect; (b) per-class weakness in cancer-associated stroma (recall 0.546) and smooth muscle (F1 0.735) is a domain-level finding for downstream interpretation; (c) prior-art quotes (ghostnet_vgg_robustness, temp_scaling_calibration) extend beyond truncated source text — verify against full papers before encoding further design decisions; (d) OOD aggregate, when computed in a future stage, must be the arithmetic mean of per-severity AUROCs, not a pooled-sample AUROC; (e) llm_model_digest is null for qwen3.8 (auxiliary, non-blocking). None of these advisory items constitute a deterministic finding or justify stopping the pipeline.
